3430-3995-5268.easyPrerequisites:
Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
Utopia Vow is attached to Horseshoe Crab.
3430-3995-5268.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2577-5147-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5147-6664-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-2842-4681-5170.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

824-2728-2921-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-2921-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-2921-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2169-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3184-4766--190.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur trigger.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-6248-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-6248-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Phenomenon Investigators triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

500-2523-6753-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bard and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Bard token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Bards dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Bard that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Bards you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

360-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1417-1580-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7297-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1824-2530-4740-6556.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4740-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1824-2530-4740-6556.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1394-1887-2060-5256-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Vorinclex.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Vorinclex.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1734-3967-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
1734-3967-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1978-2585-7170.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using Living Brain.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

630-2366-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4476-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4476-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

624-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Phantasmal Image
624-5299-5466.description:
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phantasmal Image's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Phantasmal Image's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Phantasmal Image's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

618-3742-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

338-3197-3641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-3641.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4484-4871-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

628-1228-1844-5571.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
Your deck size is at least two.
628-1228-1844-5571.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with an opponent chosen

1022-1055-6497.description:
Declare Lord Xander as an attacker attacking the opponent named by Sewer Nemesis. Lord Xander's second ability triggers, causing the opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, milling the remainder of their library.

1617-3908-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-3908-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Spark Double to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

722-745-3153.notablePrerequisites: Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-745-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

337-3297-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-3297-3525-4508.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Pirate" on Malcolm to "Human" or "Warrior" until end of turn.
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat from step 2.

2397-3089-4659-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

3398-3699-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Cadira does not have summoning sickness.
Cadira and Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least seven tokens.
3398-3699-4050.description:
Declare Cadira and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Cadira.
Cadira triggers, creating at least seven 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Cadira and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Rabbits, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
If you control eight or more tokens when Cadira deals combat damage, this combo nets infinite Rabbit tokens and colored mana.

147-313-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-5256.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

215-527-2635.manaNeeded: {G} plus enough mana to cast the creature card in hand
215-527-2635.notablePrerequisites:
You have a green creature card in hand with mana value equal to seven.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
215-527-2635.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to Selvala's power.
Cast any creature card in your hand with mana value seven by paying its mana cost.
Raggadragga's second ability triggers, untapping Selvala and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning the green creature with mana value seven from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-2232-3177.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
224-2232-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and  Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
